title: childrenByParentUID/openFolders are keyed by folder UID only
answers: Why must folder children lookups check item.kind === 'folder'?
Can a dashboard have an entry in childrenByParentUID?
Rule for indexing childrenByParentUID in browse-dashboards
body: Invariant: public/app/features/browse-dashboards/types.ts:BrowseDashboardsState.childrenByParentUID (and openFolders) must only ever be indexed with a folder's UID, never a dashboard's UID, even though a dashboard can share its parent folder's UID in unified storage. Enforced by the `item.kind !== 'folder' -> return false/leaf` guards in BrowseView.tsx:hasSelectedDescendants and state/hooks.ts's tree-flattening mapItem (public/app/features/browse-dashboards/state/hooks.ts). If a non-folder item is treated as having a children collection under its own UID, the tree recursion and selection-descendant walk loop infinitely (crash/hang) because the lookup under that UID resolves back to the dashboard's own sibling folder data. Any new code reading childrenByParentUID[item.uid] must first check item.kind === 'folder'.
applies: browse-dashboards state reducers/selectors/components that read childrenByParentUID or openFolders
